article.story: HAMDEN, Conn. -- — Tai Turnage scored 14 points as Quinnipiac beat Emerson 85-57 on Tuesday. Turnage also had nine rebounds and four steals for the Bobcats (3-4). Keith McKnight scored 14 points while finishing 7 of 10 from the floor, and added seven rebounds. Guillermo Gassett Ruiz finished with 11 points and two steals for the Lions. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
